_comment: Template only — the live file is policy/approvals.json (git-ignored, mode 0600).
Do not hand-edit the live file; use bin/issue-approval.sh so tokens get a TTL,
a scope and a use counter.  Shown here to document the record shape.
Validation fails closed: an empty scope is rejected, so a token that may be
used for anything has to say "*" out loud.

EXAMPLE-TOKEN-REPLACE-ME.scope: Open Chromium and go to example.com
EXAMPLE-TOKEN-REPLACE-ME.note: one exact instruction, one use, one hour

_actions.agent_s_gui_task: a live (non-dry-run) GUI task; scope is the exact instruction
_actions.openrouter_paid: a paid OpenRouter model; scope is the model id, or "*"
